title: Cloud Security Engineer
summary: A cloud security engineer keeps a company's cloud accounts, networks and workloads safe from misconfiguration and attack. They sit in the security team and work with cloud and DevOps engineers, adding guardrails to how infrastructure is built.
dailyDuties: Review cloud IAM and remove excess permissions
Find and fix misconfigurations flagged by a CSPM tool (cloud security posture management)
Review Terraform and add security guardrails to infrastructure as code
Scan IaC and container images in pipelines
Secure Kubernetes clusters, VPCs, security groups and private endpoints
Automate security checks with Python scripts

skills.expectation: Secure accounts, networks and workloads on AWS, Azure or GCP
